recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-17586 unless PA opens a new tracker for broader Patient gender wording.
issue_request: FHIR-17586 is a Published/Persuasive PA change request from STU3 asking to remove the word "attempt" from the Patient Gender and Sex Administrative Gender sentence so Patient.gender "represents an administrative gender" rather than "attempts to represent" one.
initial_application: The request was explicitly applied by git commit 6432ebd1cc2adfbc6f68656acd838b2789995661, whose patch changed source/patient/patient-notes.xml from "property attempts to represent an administrative gender" to "property represents an administrative gender". A later Patient notes rewrite in 54897cd3ffc4c700392ddae3204b41627e63b561 preserved the requested wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists patient=Patient in the active [resources] section, so source/patient/patient-notes.xml is current Patient build input. The originating Zulip thread matches the Jira wording request. FHIR-17561, from the same discussion, is a separate PC/FamilyMemberHistory issue and was not decided here.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/patient/patient-notes.xml:124 already says the basic Patient.gender property represents an administrative gender, and a source search found no stale Patient.gender attempt wording.

related_jiras.note: Same Zulip thread and Jira description identified the FamilyMemberHistory gender question as a separate PC tracker, so it was not decided as part of this Patient wording audit.
